identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Single Agent Belantamab Mafodotin Versus Pomalidomide Plus Low-dose Dexamethasone (Pom/Dex) in Participants With Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma (RRMM)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Open-Label, Randomized Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Single Agent Belantamab Mafodotin Compared to Pomalidomide Plus Lowdose Dexamethasone (Pom/Dex) in Participants With Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma (RRMM) (DREAMM 3)

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: This is an open-label, randomized and multi-center study

armGroups.label: Participants receiving Belantamab mafodotin
armGroups.description: Participants will receive belantamab mafodotin single agent dose on Day 1 of Q3W

armGroups.label: Participants receiving pom/dex
armGroups.description: Participants will receive pomalidomide daily on Days 1 to 21 of each 28-day cycle, with dexamethasone once weekly on Days 1, 8, 15 and 22.
interventionNames: Drug: Pom/dex (Pomalidomide plus low dose Dexamethasone)

interventions.name: Pom/dex (Pomalidomide plus low dose Dexamethasone)
interventions.description: Pomalidomide and Dexamethasone will be administered.
